profile.headline: Senior Cloud & Software Engineer | AWS Certified Solution Architect
profile.summary:
As a dynamic and results driven professional with 17+ years of in-depth experience in the IT industry, I am enthusiastic about new opportunities and challenges. My strengths include microservice architecture and cloud services. I am adept at building productive relationships and communicating effectively with clients, coworkers and across all levels of an organization. As a critical thinker, I am consistently able to provide solutions to challenges. 

My strong work ethic has contributed to success in progressively responsible positions in which I have demonstrated expertise in designing and customizing IT Solutions to meet client/organizational needs, and improve operational efficiency with innovative solutions following both Waterfall and Agile methodologies.

You will find more details of my qualifications and experience in the rest of my linked in page and my resume is available upon request.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Software Engineer, I continue to support enterprise application development and enhancement, focusing on Java 17 and Spring MVC. My work includes implementing application features across the full technology stack, maintaining integrations with external services and REST APIs, and developing SQL queries to support backend data operations. I also contribute to technical documentation and collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver reliable, maintainable software solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Software Infrastructure · Software Development

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description: As an Advisory Software Engineer, I design and implement application solutions across all three application layers using Java 17 and Spring MVC. My responsibilities include developing technical design documentation for application enhancements, integrating applications with external web services and REST APIs, and writing SQL queries to retrieve data from backend databases. I collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver application enhancements and maintain reliable, effective software solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and built RESTful APIs using Java 17, Spring Boot, and Quarkus for secure enterprise applications.
Led Helm-based deployment standardization for containerized services deployed to IBM OpenShift clusters.
Evaluated enterprise technology adoption initiatives, analyzing architectural fit, security implications, and operational risk.
Participated in architectural refinement and solution design sessions within Agile delivery cycles.
Mentored developers and enforced code quality standards through peer reviews and DevSecOps practices.
Key Achievements:
Led team-wide adoption of Helm charts to standardize IBM OpenShift deployments, improving release consistency and reducing configuration errors.
Researched and evaluated emerging technologies by authoring a comprehensive white paper assessing risks and recommending mitigation strategies for generative AI.
positions.insights: Skills: Generative AI · Team Mentoring · Software Development · RESTful architecture · RESTful WebServices · Open-Source Software · Agile Application Development · Java Development · Unit Testing · Helm Charts · Spring MVC · Databases · Cross-team Collaboration · DevSecOps · Data Structures · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · API Development · OpenShift · Maven

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented scalable microservices using Java and Spring Boot within AWS environments, incorporating event-driven communication patterns to decouple services and improve system resiliency.
Developed RESTful APIs backed by Redis, Cassandra, and Oracle, while integrating asynchronous workflows for high-volume financial transaction processing. 	
Leveraged AWS services and messaging patterns to support distributed processing and improve system scalability.
Designed services with loose coupling and fault tolerance, enabling independent deployment and improved failure isolation.
Owned monitoring and observability of distributed services using Splunk and New Relic to trace request flows and diagnose cross-service latency.
Conducted AWS active-passive failover exercises to validate resiliency across event-driven and synchronous service boundaries.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to modernize legacy patterns into scalable cloud-native architectures.
Key Achievements:
Led the troubleshooting and resolution efforts to fix a highly critical production issue that affected response times and service reliability. As a result, pricing clusters are 100% reliable and can provide the same level of service with only 66% of EC2 instances. Additionally, my team was recognized and received the highest company-wide award.
Analyzed, Designed, and Implemented a tailored solution to onboard applications from Tesla dealers into the Capital One car loan business: as a result, Capital One can now service loans for clients with a high sales projection.
Owned cloud-based failover exercises to validate the API’s resiliency level, documented and instructed the team on the process, validation, and monitoring using Splunk, New Relic, and AWS.
Developed and documented standards, best practices, and onboarding information for the team’s knowledge base. As a result, new developers can increase team productivity faster.

positions.title: Senior IT Development Specialist
positions.description:
Supervised a small development team which focuses on troubleshooting production issues, and led cross-functional teams to facilitate resolutions.
Produced design documents following object oriented design standards.
Developed back end web services using SOA which integrate with both internal and external services using SOA architecture.
Resolved numerous defects in all layers of the MVC architecture using Java, JavaScript and SQL.
Established lunch and learn session in team to educate and mentor team members.
Technologies used: Java 6, JavaScript, JSON, JSP, SOAP, XML, XSD, Struts, MVC, SQL, WebSphere Application Server, Apache, Linux, Oracle, eclipse
Key Achievements:
Under my tenure, our team was able to reduce the amount of open tickets for residential order management systems from nine hundred to three hundred in an period of six months in a queue which received tickets on a daily basis

positions.title: Sr Ecommerce Developer
positions.description:
Performed requirements gathering and solution design using object oriented standards.
Developed a REST Web Services interface for Websphere Commerce using Swagger.
Resolved numerous WebSphere Commerce defects in all levels of the MVC architecture
Managed the design and implementation of the nightly processes that share data with vendors such as IBM Coremetrics, Bazaarvoice, Golden Feeds and Google Analytics.
Implemented client side Coremetrics tagging on the main site for products, categories and orders
Mentored junior level developer on object oriented design and Java development best practices 
Performed periodic web application security audits on fossil sites according to WASP
Developed Adobe Experience Manager components for new site using Java and Mongo DB
Technologies used: Java 6, JavaScript, JSON, JSP, REST, Swagger, Coremetrics, WASP, SQL, Websphere Commerce, DB2
Key Achievements: 
Redesigned and implemented Java processes following object oriented design best practices which led to accurate Coremetrics reporting, correct product recommendations and company products sold in other sites such as Amazon and Google now display accurate information and availability.

positions.title: IT Specialist, Websphere Commerce Developer
positions.description:
Effectively analyze system requirements, design and implement Websphere Commerce Solutions to meet client needs
Perform store catalog administration using Management Center for WebSphere Commerce.
Resolve defects on JSP, JavaScript, HTML and Websphere Commerce commands in catalog, product display and management center workspaces.
Key Achievements: 
Designed and implemented Coremetrics and Omniture web analytics for a major appliance retailer. 
Implemented new functionality for a product list page to allow users to apply multiple filters on the same panel, updating the result set dynamically by the use of AJAX calls against an Endeca data source.

positions.title: IT specialist, J2EE Developer
positions.description:
Key contributor to the execution of technical administrative tasks such as application deployments to WebSphere application servers, code compilation and server memory management.
Upgraded rich Internet applications to be compliant with government accessibility standards.
Resolved defects through the effective use of a defect tracking process.
Key Achievement:
Analyzed, designed and implemented a unica netinsight web analytics solution for the website.
Created a solution for a web application with dynamic content to read out loud messages and interact with visually impaired users through a JAWS screen reader.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Managed the design, development, testing and deployment of new and existing applications in the main intranet site.
Developed reporting applications using SQL statements on an informix database.
Key Achievements: 
Designed and implemented a web based job application tool using JSP, JDBC and an Informix Database.
